description: Reference-free stability check: does an assistant's answer stay the same when the QUESTION is transformed (case, typo, paraphrase, reorder, translation)? You bring the outputs; no model is called (tfidf mode is deterministic and free). Default thresholds: case .95, typo .90, paraphrase .80, reorder .80, translation .75 (embeddings only), specialization .60 (advisory, never gated). Returns PASS / FAIL / INVALID — INVALID when the BASE answer is a refusal or too short, so a model that refuses everything never scores 1.0. Pair with run_semantic_tests for correctness.

base.output: Paris is the capital and largest city of France.

variants.output: Paris is the capital and largest city of France.

output.description: The answer to the original question.

baseline_guard.description: Floor on the BASE answer; failing it returns INVALID.

must_not_match.description: Refusal patterns, checked in the first 200 chars. Replaces the default FR+EN list; [] disables.

mode.description: tfidf (default, lexical: gate on case/typo, read paraphrase as a trend) or embeddings (OpenAI, needs api_key; required for translation).

require_all.description: Default true: every gated variant must pass. Keep it for a gate — false lets one easy typo row hold the run at PASS while a paraphrase fails.

thresholds.description: Per-relation overrides, 0-1. Calibrate on your own data before gating.

variants.description: Answers to transformed versions of the question.

output.description: The answer to the transformed question.

relation.description: Transformation applied to the question; sets the metric and threshold.

name: metamorphic_check
